Title: Public preview: API Management and Event Grid integration

Body.Content:
We are announcing the preview capabilities of integration of Azure API Management with Azure Event Grid. With this, you can configure API Management to publish events to Event Grid to send event notifications to other services and trigger downstream processes. For example, you can publish events to Event Grid whenever a new user is created, or a new subscription is created on an API Management resource.

Learn more.
